product.title: Dali Museum & Cadaques Small Group Tour with Hotel pick-up

description.text: Enter the mind of Salvador Dalí during this intimate exploration of the surrealist’s preferred haunts, with 2-way transfers from your Barcelona address. Visit Figueres, the artist’s birthplace, home of his eponymous museum; explore Cadaqués, a small coastal village along the Costa Brava; and continue to Portlligat, a tiny fishing cove. Stops include Dalí Theatre-Museum, Figueres, Cadaqués, Portlligat. Entrance fees for the Dalí sites are payable to your guide on the day. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
